description.zh:
是否自动付费。取值：

- **true**：自动支付订单。
- **false**（默认值）：在订单中心中进行支付。

> 该参数仅对预付费实例有效。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

- **true**: automatically completes the payment.

- **false** (default): If you select this option, you must complete the payment in the Order Center.

> This parameter takes effect only for subscription instances.
The ID of the CLB instance.

description.zh:
负载均衡实例的规格。取值：

 - **slb.s1.small**
 - **slb.s2.small**
 - **slb.s2.medium**
 -  **slb.s3.small**
 - **slb.s3.medium**
 - **slb.s3.large**

每个地域支持的规格不同。关于每种规格的说明，参见[性能保障型实例](~~85931~~)。	  

> 将共享型实例变更为保障型实例，SLB将有小概率可能性出现短暂的业务中断（10~30秒），建议您在业务低谷期进行变配，或者通过DNS实现实例间的负载均衡后，再进行变配操作。
description.en:
The specification of the CLB instance. Valid values:

- **slb.s1.small**

- **slb.s2.small**

- **slb.s2.medium**

- **slb.s3.small**

- **slb.s3.medium**

- **slb.s3.large**

The specifications available vary by region. For more information about the specifications, see [](t15641.xdita#).

> When you switch a shared-resource CLB instance to a high-performance CLB instance, your service may be interrupted for 10 to 30 seconds. We recommend that you modify the specification during off-peak hours or use Alibaba Cloud DNS to schedule your workloads to another CLB instance before you modify the specification.

description.zh:
负载均衡实例的地域ID。

您可以从[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)列表或通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~27584~~)接口查询地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the CLB instance.

You can query the region ID from the [](t1938333.xdita#) list or by calling the [](t4189.xdita#) operation.

title.zh: 修改负载均衡的实例规格
title.en: Modify the specification of a CLB instance

descriptions.zh:
<props="china">仅按规格计费实例支持调用ModifyLoadBalancerInstanceSpec接口，按使用量计费实例不支持调用该接口。</props>

<props="intl">CLB按规格计费实例已于2025年06月01日00:00:00（北京时间，UTC+8）停止售卖。详情请参见[传统型负载均衡CLB按规格计费实例停售公告](~~2872003~~)。
</props>
descriptions.en: Pay-by-specification CLB instances have been discontinued since 00:00:00 on June 1, 2025 (UTC+8). For more information, see [](t2857909.xdita#).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun slb modify-load-balancer-instance-spec --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-bp1b6c719df000000000 --load-balancer-spec slb.s2.small --auto-pay false --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
